description: This file is a server entry point for a Node.js application, responsible for environment setup, PID file management, server startup, and graceful shutdown procedures. It initializes an Express app, connects to MongoDB via Mongoose, and manages process lifecycle events.

methods.name: ensurePidFileGuard
methods.description: Checks for existing PID file and active process to prevent multiple instances.

methods.name: writePidFile
methods.description: Writes current process PID to the PID file.

methods.name: removePidFile
methods.description: Removes the PID file during shutdown.

methods.name: startServerStrict
methods.description: Starts the server, sets up error handling, and manages graceful shutdown.
